title: Investors Worried About Large Cap Concentration Risk Have a Great Option in MDY
summary: The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSEARCA:SPY) tells a story of increasing concentration. The S&P 500 has become a technology-dominated index, with information technology representing over a third of its weight.
